title: Wa Waila Husaina
body:
1 Kushta shod asbaabe jahaa sibe Rasool wussaqalay
Waa waila Husainam waa waila Husain
2 Kis tarah Gazi tere ki gayi joro jafaa
Waa waila Husainam waa waila Husain
3 Kis tarah se kaata gaya sibte Nabi ka gala
Waa waila Husainam waa waila Husain
4 Chin lit thi zaalimo ne sabke saro se ridaa
Waa waila Husainam waa waila Husain
